name: appstream-omniverse
title: NVIDIA Omniverse on AppStream 2.0
description: NVIDIA Omniverse Kit streamed from an AppStream 2.0 GPU fleet (Accelerated.g6e.xlarge, NICE DCV) in eu-central-1, with an optional Nucleus EC2 server and a CloudWatch metrics dashboard behind CloudFront. Start sets the fleet to one instance and starts it (and the Nucleus instance when configured); Stop scales the fleet to zero and stops both. The AppStream image, the CDK base stack and the dashboard stay deployed.

sequence: ec2:StartInstances InstanceIds=<NUCLEUS_INSTANCE_ID> (only when config.json nucleus.enabled is true)
ec2:StopInstances InstanceIds=<NUCLEUS_INSTANCE_ID> (only when config.json nucleus.enabled is true)

hourly_cost_usd_source.status: FROM PRICE LIST API: 3.52 USD is the on-demand price per instance-hour of one Accelerated.g6e.xlarge AppStream 2.0 fleet instance (Windows, License Included, instanceFunction Fleet, usagetype EUC1-Accelerated.g6e.xlarge-fl, 3.515 USD rounded to 2 decimals) in eu-central-1 (EU (Frankfurt)), retrieved 2026-09-29 with aws pricing get-products (service code AmazonAppStream, endpoint us-east-1). The c5.2xlarge Nucleus EC2 hour is not included; see nucleus_hourly_cost_usd.
hourly_cost_usd_source.command: aws pricing get-products --service-code AmazonAppStream --region us-east-1 --filters Type=TERM_MATCH,Field=location,Value="EU (Frankfurt)" Type=TERM_MATCH,Field=instanceType,Value=Accelerated.g6e.xlarge
hourly_cost_usd_source.nucleus_note: c5.2xlarge Linux on-demand EC2 instance-hour in eu-central-1 (usagetype EUC1-BoxUsage:c5.2xlarge), retrieved 2026-09-29 with aws pricing get-products --service-code AmazonEC2 --region us-east-1; add it to hourly_cost_usd while config.json nucleus.enabled is true (3.52 + 0.39 = 3.91 USD per hour)
hourly_cost_usd_source.covers: one Accelerated.g6e.xlarge AppStream 2.0 instance-hour (ON_DEMAND fleet, eu-central-1); add one c5.2xlarge EC2 instance-hour while nucleus.enabled is true
hourly_cost_usd_source.note: owner fills from the AppStream pricing page to override the Price List API value

url_source.note: The demo link is the metrics dashboard (CloudFront URL, DashboardUrl output of stack AppStreamOmniverseStack). The Omniverse streaming URL is not a fixed link: it is created per session with 'aws appstream create-streaming-url' against AppStream stack appstream-omniverse-stack and fleet appstream-omniverse-fleet, as in the README section 'Test It'.

nucleus_instance_source.note: Only present when config.json nucleus.enabled is true. The launcher reads the id from its own config.json key demos.appstream_omniverse.nucleus_instance_id; an empty string means no Nucleus instance.
